we acquired quantitative mass spectrometry data from the analysis of enriched fractions of biotinylated peptides derived from three biological replicates.

Two-state SILAC was performed for cells used in this study.
alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide

carbamidomethylation of cysteine (+57.02 Da) as a fixed modification and f) oxidation of methionine (+15.99 Da), 13C6, 15N2-lysine (K8),13C6, 15N4-arginine (R10), biotinylation of lysine (+226.07 Da), biotinylation of heavy lysine (+234.09) as variable modifications
The eluted sample was further cleaned up using C18 reversed-phase column and subject to LC-MS/MS analysis.
Cells expressing TNK2 FL-BirA* and TNK2 ΔC-BirA* were cultured overnight with 50 mM biotin.
we performed immunoaffinity-based enrichment of biotinylated peptides using an anti-biotin antibody
peptide samples dissolved in BioSITe capture buffer (50 mM Tris, 150 mM NaCl, 0.5% Triton X-100) were incubated with anti-biotin antibody bound to protein-G beads
